title: 油价周二延续跌势
summary: 布伦特原油在周一下跌近8%的基础上进一步下跌1.8%，至每桶102.84美元。此前有报道称美伊之间的外交努力取得进展。

title: Jordan carries out deadly strike in Syria in retaliation for church attack
summary: The attack on a village in Syria killed five people, including women and children, Syrian health officials said.

title: Four tankers destroyed by naval mines in Strait of Hormuz, Iran's IRGC says
summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says the vessels had hit sea mines while trying to cross a prohibited route.

title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
summary: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.
